title: Machine learning predicts breath-hold ineligibility in left breast radiotherapy
summary: The model reached AUC 0.803 (0.686-0.941) and recall 0.526 in temporal validation on 47 patients; clinical impact was tested in a separate cohort of 64 patients. Derivation used 202 patients at a single centre and recall is modest.
ai_technology: Gradient-boosting machine learning model using day-1 data
organization: Rajiv Gandhi Cancer Institute & Research Centre, New Delhi, India

evidence.tested: Temporal validation 47 patients; separate prospective cohort of 64
evidence.unknown: Single centre; derivation n=202; modest recall; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Gradient-boosting ML predicts DIBH ineligibility from day-1 data in left breast cancer radiotherapy

source_review.scope: Abstract and author affiliations read from Europe PMC metadata for this DOI. Publisher full text not accessed.
